reason: No ads and works offline sounds good, so I would install the free version and watch how my child uses it. But 24,990 every month for an app, when I do not even know what PRO adds beyond the free part, I will not pay in the first month.
objection: Paying every month for a phone app is a lot, and I am not sure it is better than the free cartoons and YouTube lessons, or that it will not just mean more screen time.
would_change_my_mind: If after a few weeks on the free version I saw my child actually reading letters and counting in Russian, and the parent area showed me real progress, I would pay for the year.
